title: 基于多目标强化学习与大语言模型的帕累托最优RTL代码生成
summary: 该研究提出首个面向LLM电路生成的多目标强化学习方法，不再优化单个电路质量，而是优化多次生成所得电路集合在PPA目标空间中的质量与多样性。方法包含基于生成的训练流程和基于超体积贡献（HVC）的奖励函数，在RTLLM v2基准上相对超体积较无PPA优化基线提升13.3个百分点，较单目标强化学习提升14.4个百分点，并在电路多样性上表现更优。
summary_en: This work proposes the first multi-objective RL method for LLM-based circuit generation that optimizes the quality and diversity of the entire generated circuit set in PPA space, rather than a single circuit. It combines a generation-based training pipeline with a Hypervolume Contribution (HVC) reward. On RTLLM v2, it improves relative Hypervolume by +13.3 points over a no-PPA-optimization baseline and +14.4 points over single-objective RL, with better circuit diversity.
